description: The entity does not provide data subjects with access to their personal information for review and update. This signal indicates that individuals lack the ability to view, verify, or modify their own personal data held by the organization, which is a fundamental privacy requirement.
applicability: Applicable to any system, application, or service that processes personal information and should provide data subjects with access rights. Includes customer portals, self-service platforms, data access request workflows, and privacy management systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of privacy policies, self-service portal capabilities, data subject request procedures, and system functionality. May be identified by absence of access request mechanisms, lack of user portals, or missing processes for responding to access requests.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
